path_notes: Built by team-lead, at fenix's direction and from fenix's cited source comments, directly from ATM messages in the fenix/quality-mgr queues (atm list <target> --from <sender> --all --json) and the GitHub issue-comments API for each PR's Final Quality Report / QA Findings Update. Every assignment_message_id is fenix's dispatch message to quality-mgr carrying that QA task id; every result_message_id is quality-mgr's nearest message to fenix referencing the same task id (for BA.2 QA-1/QA-2 this is a --task-complete-refused note sent immediately after the verdict, not the verdict text itself -- atm list only exposes truncated summaries of another agent's mailbox, so the verbatim verdict text for every run comes from the cited GitHub comment, fetched in full via gh api and quoted/paraphrased faithfully in each run's evidence field). No verdict, count, ruling, or message id was fabricated; null means the value is not carried by the source message. The historical AX file's `pass` field holds QA-round-label strings (e.g. "QA-1"); the AY file's holds booleans. This file follows AY's boolean convention (pass == (verdict == "PASS")) since `verdict` already carries the round label's PASS/FAIL meaning as a string -- this divergence between the two precedent files is a pre-existing schema inconsistency, not something resolved here.
